deletion_retention_product.statement: V1 deletion unlinks superseded bytes from the primary consumer-visible archive while retaining governed disaster-recovery bytes; it provides neither normal point-in-time source replay nor secure erasure from every backup medium.

deletion_retention_operations.statement: Operations accepts the V1 primary-unlink and governed recovery-retention policy and its backup, restore, and cleanup obligations.

full_market_scope_product.statement: V1 full market is the independently reconciled snapshot-time still-listed RMB A-share universe on SSE, SZSE, and BSE; historical delisted securities are excluded from scheduled coverage.

rollout_effect.reason: Required product and operations sign-offs have not been supplied.
